title: FloodPay Annual Premium, Sensor Fees and Surplus Lines Tax
content:
## Billing desk note — what a FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines) policy is charged

**The rule.** The annual premium is the tier's base rate percent of the payout limit multiplied by the zone factor for the location's flood zone, rounded to the tier's premium rounding increment and never less than the tier's minimum premium. The installation fee is booked once at binding and the annual monitoring fee at each term start; the surplus lines tax is the recorded rate applied to the premium, and to the fees when the tier's fees are taxable, rounded to the cent. Payment is in full under the Annual plan.

### The annual premium, in order

1. The starting amount is the tier's base rate percent of the tier's payout limit.
2. That amount is multiplied by the zone factor for the FEMA flood zone recorded for the location.
3. The product is rounded to the tier's premium rounding increment.
4. Where the rounded amount is below the tier's minimum premium, the annual premium is the minimum premium; otherwise it is the rounded amount.

The minimum is compared with the rounded amount, and the annual premium is stated before fees and taxes.

The figures the premium reads, by tier:

| Tier | Payout limit (USD) | Base rate (% of the payout limit) | Minimum annual premium (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| FloodPay Home 5K | 5000 | 4.8 | 120 |
| FloodPay Home 10K | 10000 | 4.5 | 220 |
| FloodPay Home 25K | 25000 | 4.1 | 500 |
| FloodPay Business 50K | 50000 | 3.9 | 950 |
| FloodPay Business 100K | 100000 | 3.7 | 1800 |
| FloodPay Business 250K | 250000 | 3.4 | 4250 |

### Fees and tax

| Item | When it is booked | Bears surplus lines tax |
|---|---|---|
| Annual premium | At binding for the first term; at renewal for each renewed term | Yes |
| Installation fee | Once, at binding | Yes, when the tier's fees are taxable |
| Annual monitoring fee | At each term start | Yes, when the tier's fees are taxable |
| Surplus lines tax | With the items it is charged on | — |

The surplus lines tax rate is the rate in force recorded on the policy for the state whose surplus lines tax applies; it is not a tier figure. Each premium, fee or tax item raises the amount the policyholder owes, and payments lower it.

### Worked example on hypothetical figures

*Hypothetical inputs:* payout limit 35,000 US dollars; base rate 2.9 percent; zone factor 0.95; minimum premium 1,000 US dollars; installation fee 100 and monitoring fee 50 US dollars, both taxable; recorded surplus lines tax rate 4.94 percent.

- 2.9 percent of 35,000 is 1,015.
- 1,015 multiplied by 0.95 is 964.25; rounded to a 1-dollar increment, 964.
- 964 is below the minimum of 1,000, so the annual premium is 1,000.
- The taxable amount is the premium of 1,000 together with the fees of 150, 1,150 in all; 4.94 percent of it is 56.81 after rounding to the cent.
- The first-term amount payable in full under the Annual plan is 1,000 premium, 100 installation fee, 50 monitoring fee and 56.81 tax: 1,206.81 US dollars.

*Variation on the same hypothetical:* with a minimum premium of 900 instead, the rounded 964 is not below the minimum and stands as the annual premium.

### Basis Q&A

**Is the minimum premium applied before or after the fees and tax are added?**
Before. The minimum premium is a floor on the annual premium, which is stated before fees and taxes.

**Is the installation fee charged again at renewal?**
No. It is booked once, at binding; the monitoring fee is the fee booked at each term start.
